packageRules.description: Hold the GitHub-hosted runner at ubuntu-24.04. On ubuntu-26.04 (#872) the GUI smoke suite fails wholesale: dogtail stops finding the apps' push buttons over AT-SPI ('New Document', 'Close', 'Add sheet'), and test_gui_harness.py's process-ownership test kills a process it did not start. Moving runners is a migration of the GUI harness, not a version bump. Remove this rule in the PR that makes the suite pass on 26.04.
Hold the rdocx family at 0.16.2 until the Letters adapters support 0.16.3, and group the eventual upgrade so incompatible partial updates are not proposed (#1725).
